2	import type { HookEvent } from './_deps.js'
3	import {
4	  clearRegisteredPluginHooks,
5	  getRegisteredHooks,
6	  registerHookCallbacks,

8	import type { LoadedPlugin } from './types.js'
9	import { logForDebugging } from './_deps.js'
10	import { settingsChangeDetector } from '../settings/changeDetector.js'
11	import {
12	  getSettings,

15	import type { PluginHookMatcher } from '../settings/types.js'
16	import { jsonStringify } from './_deps.js'
17	import { clearPluginCache, loadAllPluginsCacheOnly } from './pluginLoader.js'

20	let hotReloadSubscribed = false

25	/**
26	 * Convert plugin hooks configuration to native matchers with plugin context
27	 */
28	function convertPluginHooksToMatchers(
29	  plugin: LoadedPlugin,
30	): Record<HookEvent, PluginHookMatcher[]> {
31	  const pluginMatchers: Record<HookEvent, PluginHookMatcher[]> = {
32	    SessionStart: [],
33	    SessionEnd: [],
34	    UserPromptSubmit: [],
35	    PreToolUse: [],
36	    PostToolUse: [],
37	    Stop: [],
38	    SubagentStart: [],
39	    SubagentStop: [],
40	    PreModelSwitch: [],
41	    PostModelSwitch: [],
42	    PreCompact: [],
43	    PostCompact: [],
44	  }
45	
46	  if (!plugin.hooksConfig) {
47	    return pluginMatchers
48	  }
49	
50	  // Process each hook event - pass through all hook types with plugin context
51	  for (const [event, matchers] of Object.entries(plugin.hooksConfig)) {
52	    const hookEvent = event as HookEvent
53	    if (!pluginMatchers[hookEvent]) {
54	      continue
55	    }
56	
57	    for (const matcher of matchers) {
58	      if (matcher.hooks.length > 0) {
59	        pluginMatchers[hookEvent].push({
60	          matcher: matcher.matcher,
61	          hooks: matcher.hooks,
62	          pluginRoot: plugin.path,
63	          pluginName: plugin.name,
64	          pluginId: plugin.source,
65	        })
66	      }
67	    }
68	  }
69	
70	  return pluginMatchers
71	}

73	/**
74	 * Load and register hooks from all enabled plugins
75	 */
76	export const loadPluginHooks = memoize(async (): Promise<void> => {
77	  const { enabled } = await loadAllPluginsCacheOnly()
78	  const allPluginHooks: Record<HookEvent, PluginHookMatcher[]> = {
79	    SessionStart: [],
80	    SessionEnd: [],
81	    UserPromptSubmit: [],
82	    PreToolUse: [],
83	    PostToolUse: [],
84	    Stop: [],
85	    SubagentStart: [],
86	    SubagentStop: [],
87	    PreModelSwitch: [],
88	    PostModelSwitch: [],
89	    PreCompact: [],
90	    PostCompact: [],
91	  }
92	
93	  // Process each enabled plugin
94	  for (const plugin of enabled) {
95	    if (!plugin.hooksConfig) {
96	      continue
97	    }
98	
99	    logForDebugging(`Loading hooks from plugin: ${plugin.name}`)
100	    const pluginMatchers = convertPluginHooksToMatchers(plugin)
101	
102	    // Merge plugin hooks into the main collection
103	    for (const event of Object.keys(pluginMatchers) as HookEvent[]) {
104	      allPluginHooks[event].push(...pluginMatchers[event])
105	    }
106	  }
107	
108	  // Clear-then-register as an atomic pair. Previously the clear lived in
109	  // clearPluginHookCache(), which meant any clearAllCaches() call (from
110	  // /plugins UI, pluginInstallationHelpers, thinkback, etc.) wiped plugin
111	  // hooks from STATE.registeredHooks and left them wiped until someone
112	  // happened to call loadPluginHooks() again. SessionStart explicitly awaits
113	  // loadPluginHooks() before firing so it always re-registered; Stop has no
114	  // such guard, so plugin Stop hooks silently never fired after any plugin
115	  // management operation (gh-29767). Doing the clear here makes the swap
116	  // atomic — old hooks stay valid until this point, new hooks take over.
117	  clearRegisteredPluginHooks()
118	  registerHookCallbacks(allPluginHooks)
119	
120	  const totalHooks = Object.values(allPluginHooks).reduce(
121	    (sum, matchers) => sum + matchers.reduce((s, m) => s + m.hooks.length, 0),
122	    0,
123	  )
124	  logForDebugging(
125	    `Registered ${totalHooks} hooks from ${enabled.length} plugins`,
126	  )
127	})

129	export function clearPluginHookCache(): void {
130	  // Only invalidate the memoize — do NOT wipe STATE.registeredHooks here.
131	  // Wiping here left plugin hooks dead between clearAllCaches() and the next
132	  // loadPluginHooks() call, which for Stop hooks might never happen
133	  // (gh-29767). The clear now lives inside loadPluginHooks() as an atomic
134	  // clear-then-register, so old hooks stay valid until the fresh load swaps
135	  // them out.
136	  loadPluginHooks.cache?.clear?.()
137	}

139	/**
140	 * Remove hooks from plugins no longer in the enabled set, without adding
141	 * hooks from newly-enabled plugins. Called from clearAllCaches() so
142	 * uninstalled/disabled plugins stop firing hooks immediately (gh-36995),
143	 * while newly-enabled plugins wait for /reload-plugins — consistent with
144	 * how commands/agents/MCP behave.
145	 *
146	 * The full swap (clear + register all) still happens via loadPluginHooks(),
147	 * which /reload-plugins awaits.
148	 */
149	export async function pruneRemovedPluginHooks(): Promise<void> {
150	  // Early return when nothing to prune — avoids seeding the loadAllPluginsCacheOnly
151	  // memoize in test/preload.ts beforeEach (which clears registeredHooks).
152	  if (!getRegisteredHooks()) return
153	  const { enabled } = await loadAllPluginsCacheOnly()
154	  const enabledRoots = new Set(enabled.map(p => p.path))
155	
156	  // Re-read after the await: a concurrent loadPluginHooks() (hot-reload)
157	  // could have swapped STATE.registeredHooks during the gap. Holding the
158	  // pre-await reference would compute survivors from stale data.
159	  const current = getRegisteredHooks()
160	  if (!current) return
161	
162	  // Collect plugin hooks whose pluginRoot is still enabled, then swap via
163	  // the existing clear+register pair (same atomic-pair pattern as
164	  // loadPluginHooks above). Callback hooks are preserved by
165	  // clearRegisteredPluginHooks; we only need to re-register survivors.
166	  const survivors: Partial<Record<HookEvent, PluginHookMatcher[]>> = {}
167	  for (const [event, matchers] of Object.entries(current)) {
168	    // `current` cruza la frontera de _deps.ts tipado como `unknown[]`,
169	    // aunque en runtime es un mapa por evento; se afirma el valor real
170	    // (un arreglo) antes de filtrarlo, sin asumirlo sin comprobar.
171	    if (!Array.isArray(matchers)) continue
172	    const kept = matchers.filter(
173	      (m: { pluginRoot: string }): m is PluginHookMatcher =>
174	        'pluginRoot' in m && enabledRoots.has(m.pluginRoot),
175	    )
176	    if (kept.length > 0) survivors[event as HookEvent] = kept
177	  }
178	
179	  clearRegisteredPluginHooks()
180	  registerHookCallbacks(survivors)
181	}

183	/**
184	 * Reset hot reload subscription state. Only for testing.
185	 */
186	export function resetHotReloadState(): void {
187	  hotReloadSubscribed = false
188	  lastPluginSettingsSnapshot = undefined
189	}

191	/**
192	 * Build a stable string snapshot of the settings that feed into
193	 * `loadAllPluginsCacheOnly()` for change detection. Sorts keys so comparison is
194	 * deterministic regardless of insertion order.
195	 *
196	 * Hashes FOUR fields — not just enabledPlugins — because the memoized
197	 * loadAllPluginsCacheOnly() also reads strictKnownMarketplaces, blockedMarketplaces
198	 * (pluginLoader.ts:1933 via getBlockedMarketplaces), and
199	 * extraKnownMarketplaces. If remote managed settings set only one of
200	 * these (no enabledPlugins), a snapshot keyed only on enabledPlugins
201	 * would never diff, the listener would skip, and the memoized result
202	 * would retain the pre-remote marketplace allow/blocklist.
203	 * See #23085 / #23152 poisoned-cache discussion (Slack C09N89L3VNJ).
204	 */
205	// Exported for testing — the listener at setupPluginHookHotReload uses this
206	// for change detection; tests verify it diffs on the fields that matter.
207	export function getPluginAffectingSettingsSnapshot(): string {
208	  const merged = getSettings()
209	  const policy = getSettingsForSource('policySettings')
210	  // Key-sort the two Record fields so insertion order doesn't flap the hash.
211	  // Array fields (strictKnownMarketplaces, blockedMarketplaces) have
212	  // schema-stable order.
213	  const sortKeys = <T extends Record<string, unknown>>(o: T | undefined) =>
214	    o ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(o).sort()) : {}
215	  // `extraKnownMarketplaces` no está en el esquema tipado de Settings
216	  // (retirado en `settings/inventory.ts`, servicio externo) y llega por el
217	  // índice `passthrough()` como `unknown`; se acota a registro antes de
218	  // ordenar sus claves, con la misma forma que ya asume
219	  // `addDirPluginSettings.ts` al leerlo.
220	  const extraKnownMarketplaces =
221	    typeof merged.extraKnownMarketplaces === 'object' &&
222	    merged.extraKnownMarketplaces !== null
223	      ? (merged.extraKnownMarketplaces as Record<string, unknown>)
224	      : undefined
225	  return jsonStringify({
226	    enabledPlugins: sortKeys(merged.enabledPlugins),
227	    extraKnownMarketplaces: sortKeys(extraKnownMarketplaces),
228	    strictKnownMarketplaces: policy?.strictKnownMarketplaces ?? [],
229	    blockedMarketplaces: policy?.blockedMarketplaces ?? [],
230	  })
231	}
232	
233	/**
234	 * Set up hot reload for plugin hooks when remote settings change.
235	 * When policySettings changes (e.g., from remote managed settings),
236	 * compares the plugin-affecting settings snapshot and only reloads if it
237	 * actually changed.
238	 */
239	export function setupPluginHookHotReload(): void {
240	  if (hotReloadSubscribed) {
241	    return
242	  }
243	  hotReloadSubscribed = true
244	
245	  // Capture the initial snapshot so the first policySettings change can compare
246	  lastPluginSettingsSnapshot = getPluginAffectingSettingsSnapshot()
247	
248	  settingsChangeDetector.subscribe(source => {
249	    if (source === 'policySettings') {
250	      const newSnapshot = getPluginAffectingSettingsSnapshot()
251	      if (newSnapshot === lastPluginSettingsSnapshot) {
252	        logForDebugging(
253	          'Plugin hooks: skipping reload, plugin-affecting settings unchanged',
254	        )
255	        return
256	      }
257	
258	      lastPluginSettingsSnapshot = newSnapshot
259	      logForDebugging(
260	        'Plugin hooks: reloading due to plugin-affecting settings change',
261	      )
262	
263	      // Clear all plugin-related caches
264	      clearPluginCache('loadPluginHooks: plugin-affecting settings changed')
265	      clearPluginHookCache()
266	
267	      // Reload hooks (fire-and-forget, don't block)
268	      void loadPluginHooks()
269	    }
270	  })
271	}

179	    mkdirSync: (p, o) => fs.mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true, ...(o ?? {}) }),
180	    writeFileSync: (p, d) => fs.writeFileSync(p, d),
181	    readFileSync: (p, e) => fs.readFileSync(p, e) as string,
182	    readdirSync: p =>

184	    statSync: p =>
185	      fs.statSync(p) as PluginStats,
186	    rmSync: (p, o) => fs.rmSync(p, o),
187	    rmdirSync: p => fs.rmdirSync(p),

194	    readFileBytes: async p => new Uint8Array(await fsp.readFile(p)),
195	    writeFile: async (p, d) => fsp.writeFile(p, d),
196	    mkdir: async (p, o) => {

198	    },

881	    const colonIdx = trimmed.indexOf(':')
882	    if (colonIdx === -1) continue
883	    const key = trimmed.slice(0, colonIdx).trim()
884	    let value: unknown = trimmed.slice(colonIdx + 1).trim()

894	        value = false
895	      }
896	    }
